classification.difficultyReason: Recognise each shape decomposition, using right-triangle lengths and central polygon angles where required.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of each shape correct to one decimal place. All measurements are in metres.

answer.worked:
Let $d$ be the dashed diagonal.
$$\begin{align*}d&=\sqrt{7^2+24^2}\\d&=25\text{ m}\\A&=\frac12(7)(24)+\frac12(25)(15)\sin50^\circ\\A&\approx227.6\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
